title: Build a neural network
outcome: Train a small PyTorch network for the shot prediction task.

blocks.body: Question: Can learned features improve the forecast?
Mathematics: Apply the chain rule to backpropagation, the calculation of gradients through a network.
Dataset: StatsBomb Open Data: events/{match_id}.json joined to match dates. For shots, use shot locations and outcomes. Split by whole match and date.
Reading: D2L chapters on linear networks, multilayer perceptrons, and training. Keep the network small enough for local experiments.

blocks.title: Dive into Deep Learning
blocks.note: Use the interactive book for calculus, automatic differentiation, training loops, and attention.

blocks.body: Challenge: Trace a prediction and gradient through a tiny network. Explain train versus evaluation mode.

tasks.prompt: Implement a two-layer network and annotate tensor shapes. Compare a tiny manual gradient with automatic differentiation.
